# Built-in image generation — October 21, 2026

All five assets were generated using the built-in image_gen tool, not the API/CLI. Local original paths and outputs are listed in sources.json. Original images remain preserved, and consumed assets are copied into this project. Stock reference photographs were used only to understand architecture.

## Concept

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: architectural concept for a playable VR nighttime crime-scene street in Oman. Create a realistic eye-level wide architectural visualization of a modest Omani gold souk street, based on the characteristic older Muscat/Seeb commercial districts: weathered ivory and sand plaster two-storey flat-roof shop rows, restrained stepped parapets, some arched upper galleries and simple rectangular grilled windows, wall mounted air conditioners, exposed service cables, deep fascia beams, individually varied Arabic jewelry/perfume/tailor shop signs integrated into aged signboards. A cream plaster gold market gateway with small side pedestrian arches is visible down the street. Parking apron with empty marked parking bays directly beside shops, low black-and-white curbs, worn asphalt and tiled pavement. Night investigation atmosphere, subdued warm practical street lighting, most shop lights off, a little distant atmospheric haze. Main jewelry store has a dark modern glass storefront within the cream local building. Organic modest local construction, uneven weathering, realistic human scale, no European brick high street, no ornate Victorian details, no futuristic architecture. Absolutely NO cars, no vehicles, no people, no watermark. Not a screenshot or UI. Favor plausible economical architecture that can be modeled for a Quest 3 scene.

## Plaster

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless tileable base-color texture for an Omani commercial building plaster wall in a realtime game. Straight-on orthographic flat surface only, off-white warm ivory lime/cement stucco, fine sandy grain, subtle irregular sun faded patches and restrained gray-beige age marks, a few hairline cracks, tiny chips exposing slightly darker warm plaster. Believable older Muscat shop wall. Neutral flat diffuse lighting, NO directional shadows, NO ambient occlusion baked edges, NO glossy highlights, NO objects, no windows, no writing, no bricks, no broad black mold, no huge dramatic cracks. All four edges seamless; uniform material scale; restrained contrast. Entire image filled by material. Output square high resolution.

## Signs

Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: game texture atlas of four separate older Omani souk shop fascia boards, straight-on orthographic flat artwork. Composition: square image exactly divided into FOUR equal full-width horizontal strips, each strip 4:1 aspect ratio, no spacing or perspective. Each strip is a DIFFERENT plausible weathered enamel or painted sign with readable beautiful Arabic lettering, restrained bilingual secondary English and small relevant icon. TOP STRIP dark green painted metal, text verbatim 'مجوهرات الياقوت' with smaller 'AL YAQOOT JEWELLERY', subtle gold jewelry motif. SECOND STRIP faded cream with dark burgundy lettering, text verbatim 'عطور البخور' and smaller 'AL BUKHOOR PERFUMES', small incense burner motif. THIRD STRIP muted teal board, text verbatim 'خياطة النخيل' and smaller 'AL NAKHEEL TAILORING', small scissors motif. BOTTOM STRIP ivory cream sign, text verbatim 'سوق الذهب' with smaller 'GOLD MARKET', elegant dark bronze letters and small traditional geometric corner details. All Arabic must be correctly joined, right-to-left, natural professional signwriting. Signs look locally manufactured, modest, lightly sun-faded with tiny chips and dust at edges. No photographed scene, no walls, no mounting brackets, no shadows, no fake neon, no excessive glow, no extra writing, no watermark. Four strips should fill their quadrants edge to edge so each can be mapped to a physical signboard.

## Runoff

Use case: background-extraction. Asset type: transparent RGBA grime decal atlas for weathered Omani ivory plaster shop exteriors in a realistic VR game. Create ONLY subtle brown-gray vertical rain and dust runoff streaks with soft irregular translucent edges on a genuinely transparent background. Wide texture, four separate varied clusters of streaks across its width. Grime starts near the top edge in intermittent dark dusty little patches and drips downward tapering into nothing by the lower edge. Restrained pale warm ochre-gray deposits, mostly empty transparency, realistic fine surface dirt, a few fine cracks. No wall/base color/background, no objects, no text, no shadow, no white matte. Decal intended to overlay existing cream plaster under concrete parapets; age and dust, not horror black mold.


## Fine safety glass

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: transparent RGBA ground-debris texture for a realistic VR shop burglary scene. Orthographic directly overhead view of a loose scattered accumulation of genuinely shattered clear architectural safety glass: hundreds of very small irregular translucent diced glass granules and sharp angular chips, a few larger thin clear triangular fragments, dense broken-glass crumbs in the middle fading naturally to sparse individual pieces toward all edges. The entire loose scatter fits within the image with transparent margins. Colorless neutral clear glass, only extremely faint cool gray edges, NOT green. Realistic uneven microscopic chipped facets and varied piece sizes, like broken shop-door glass swept into a low loose pile. Flat soft neutral studio illumination so highlights are restrained, no dramatic directional light. Genuinely transparent background visible between and through fragments. No floor, no surface underneath, no frame, no wall, no container, no shadows outside individual chips, no text, no white solid sheet. Not foam, not snow, not paper confetti, not diamonds, not large cubic ice. This is a game cutout texture which will be lit by the game's flashlight; avoid big bright baked highlights.
